steps.label: MLE: listen to the data only
Our prior belief
MAP: data plus prior
steps.pseudocode: MAP multiplies the likelihood by the prior.

steps.label: Small data: they disagree
steps.pseudocode: With little data the prior still has a say.

steps.label: Now collect more data
steps.pseudocode: Same share of heads, more flips.

steps.label: With enough data they agree
steps.pseudocode: Once the likelihood is sharp enough, MAP lands on the MLE.

steps.label: Why ML cares
steps.pseudocode: With very little data MLE can be extreme; a prior tempers it.
